description: This file defines a React component named FileViewWithoutProtection that renders a comprehensive user interface for viewing and editing a file within a web application. It manages state for UI panels, handles file renaming with debounce, supports drag-and-drop for files, and composes several subcomponents such as FilePreview, FileOptionsPanel, and others. It appears to be part of a file management or note-taking web application.

methods.name: toggleFileInfoPanel
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the file information panel.

methods.name: onTitleChange
methods.description: Handles the change event for the file title input, with debounce to optimize renaming and sync operations.
